family: all 14 nonconstant two-bit Boolean seeds; sign tensor t copies, then fresh k-bit point activation
symmetry: none; every labeled nonconstant two-bit seed included
arithmetic: integer Walsh and edges; exact rational squared masses; 32-term positive atanh log series with rational remainder and outward rounding
analytic_domain: all finite Boolean seeds, all positive integers k,t; asymptotic t=ceil(k^2/I(seed)), k>=max(1,I(seed))
